title: [Bug] Companion v2026.10.5-alpha.4 WSL setup fails: pinned Node 24.19.0 rejected by install-cli (requires 24.22.1+)
subtitle: openclaw/openclaw-windows-node #1843
author: urielcast18
body:
## Summary

A clean local WSL Gateway setup through **OpenClaw Companion v2026.10.5-alpha.4 (Windows x64)** fails at `install-cli` because the setup engine pins **Node.js 24.19.0**, but the current OpenClaw CLI installer requires **Node.js 24.22.1+ or 26.12.1+**.

This blocks onboarding even though the Windows/WSL preflight steps succeed.

## Environment

- OpenClaw Companion: `v2026.10.5-alpha.4` (Windows x64 installer)
- OS: Windows 11 x64, build `26200.6584` (reported by WSL)
- Installation path: **Install a local Gateway (WSL)**
- WSL distro: Ubuntu 24.04 as app-owned `OpenClawGateway`
- Permissions preset: Strict

## Actual behavior

The setup progresses through WSL compatibility checks and Gateway preparation, then fails at the CLI installation step:

```text
Step 'install-cli' failed: CLI install failed (exit 1):
ERROR: Node 24.19.0 is unsupported; use Node 24.22.1+ or Node 26.12.1+.
```

The preceding log confirmed the installer invoked `wsl.exe --install --distribution Ubuntu-24.04 --name OpenClawGateway ... --no-launch --web-download`, and this subsequent failure occurs at `install-cli`. An earlier attempt had failed during `wsl-create` with exit `-1` and no output, but the latest attempt progressed beyond WSL creation.

## Source evidence

The **released tag** pins an incompatible version in `src/OpenClaw.SetupEngine/GatewayInstallPolicy.cs`:

- [v2026.10.5-alpha.4: `NodeVersion = "24.19.0"`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/v2026.10.5-alpha.4/src/OpenClaw.SetupEngine/GatewayInstallPolicy.cs)
- [Current `main`: `NodeVersion = "24.22.1"`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/blob/main/src/OpenClaw.SetupEngine/GatewayInstallPolicy.cs)

This appears to be a **release/source version drift** rather than missing WSL support or a user-provided Node installation problem.

Related older reports with the same failure pattern for a previous pinned Node version: #1364 and #1394.

## Expected behavior

The graphical Windows Companion setup should select a Node.js version accepted by the OpenClaw CLI installer and complete local Gateway setup without requiring users to manually modify WSL or install another runtime.

## Request

Could you publish a refreshed **Windows x64 Companion installer** incorporating the corrected Node pin, or provide an official GUI-supported recovery/update path for installations already blocked at `install-cli`?

No security controls or WSL isolation settings were disabled during these attempts.

comments.author: roboclaw-bot
comments.body:
The refreshed installer is now published. v2026.11.1, released November 7, includes OpenClawCompanion-Setup-x64.exe and the Node 24.22.1 correction from #1824 (fix(setup): install a Node runtime supported by the Gateway). The release tag itself pins 24.22.1, and the fixing PR records successful real WSL setup with that runtime. Closing this specific 24.19.0 rejection as fixed. Update Companion using the v2026.11.1 installer and retry the normal setup flow; no manual WSL/runtime edits or data reset are required by this correction. If it still reports 24.19.0 after updating, please reopen with the running Companion version and sanitized install-cli error. Store rollout timing and unrelated setup failures are not implied by this closure.

Release: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/releases/tag/v2026.11.1
